# 3e Router sync: contract

**Read first:** [build README → Phase 3](./README.md#phase-3-routing), [router sync](../processes/routing/router-sync.md) (steps, triggers, preview; drift, unmanaged tags, pausing and removing are 3f's), [RouterOS integration](../integrations/routeros.md) (the contract with the router, every command), [routing lists](../processes/routing/routing-lists.md) (ownership edge cases that end on a router), [ADR 0007](../adr/0007-agentless-ssh-with-pinned-host-keys.md), [ADR 0008](../adr/0008-tsnet-node-for-router-reachability.md), [ADR 0010](../adr/0010-router-contract-stays-mtvpn-compatible.md), [ADR 0013](../adr/0013-one-owner-service-per-domain.md), [jobs](../processes/platform/jobs.md) (coalescing, delay, retries, resume), `internal/platform/sshx` and `sshxtest`, designs `RP-Routers`, `RP-Router-add`, `RP-Router`, `RP-List`, and the **As built** of 3a–3d, 0e (`sshx`, pinning, `ConfirmFirstContact`) and 1d/1e (the `remote` + fake-VPS pattern this module copies for RouterOS).

**Done when:** a router can be added through **Test connection** (jump host and router fingerprints confirmed by the admin, version and board read, the router script's forwarder and pin checked) and **Save**, which queues its initial sync; every change that alters a router's desired state (3a–3d's marks) queues one coalesced sync 30 s later; **Sync now** runs one at once; a sync reads the router, plans per tag (unchanged, recorded, update, remove, unmanaged), pushes one idempotent block per tag, packed into files of at most 2 000 names, over SFTP and `/import` in the order that never loses a name, scans the output, deletes its files, verifies, and records what it applied; failures retry after 5 min, 15 min and 1 h and notify once the job gives up, and recovery after a notified failure notifies; **Preview sync** shows the plan and the exact scripts without changing anything; the router page and a basic routers list exist; every checklist line has its test against the fake RouterOS router.

Not in 3e: drift checks, unmanaged-tag actions, awaiting setup, pause, removal, the full routers list and the dashboard (3f). A sync already **reports** unmanaged tags in its plan and leaves them alone.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Service | `routers.Service` (Deps: DB, Events, Settings, Jobs, SSH, Tailnet status, `Lists`, `Services`, `Now`, Log). `Module.Routers`. `Init` sets `m.Marker = m.Routers.Marker()`, replacing `change.None`. | Build README "The sync seam". |
| Connection | `routers.Connection{Host, Port, User, JumpHost, JumpPort, JumpUser, Tailnet bool, Names routeros.Names}`. Host: a hostname or an IP (no scheme, no port), port 1–65535 (22); user `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$` (default `proxier`); a jump host is optional and needs its user; **First hop**: direct or through the tailnet (default: the tailnet when the node is running). Names: `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,63}$`, defaults `to_vpn_list` and `vpn-doh`. Target: `sshx.Target{Hop{Address: host:port, User, Subject: "router:<id>"}, Jump: &Hop{…, Subject: "jump:<host:port>"}, Network: Tailnet or Direct, FirstContact: ConfirmFirstContact}`. | router-sync.md "adding a router"; ADR 0008. |
| RouterOS text | Every command and script comes from `routing/routeros` (Build README rule). Commands: `CmdCheck` (one line of `:put ("key\|" . …)` statements: version, board, identity, the forwarder's count, the `mtvpn:doh` pin's count, the address list's static entries), `CmdReadDNS`, `CmdReadList`, `CmdImport(file)` (`/import file-name=<file> verbose=no`), `CmdRemoveFile(file)` (`:do {/file remove [find name="<file>"]} on-error={}`), `CmdRemoveJobFiles(job)` (the same with `name~"^proxier-sync-<job>-"`). Scripts: `ServiceBlock`, `RemovalBlock`, `Files`. `routeros.Parse(cmd)` and `routeros.ParseScript(body)` are their inverses, used by the fake. | routeros.md. |
| Reading | `CmdReadDNS` prints, for every `/ip dns static` entry with `address-list="<list>"`: `comment\|name\|match-subdomain\|type\|forward-to` (each through `:tostr`); `CmdReadList` prints, for every non-dynamic entry of the list: `comment\|address`. Lines are trimmed of `\r`; the fields are split from the **right** (a hand-written comment may hold `\|`). `routers.Interpret`: **tags** come from the DNS entries' comments (so address-list-only comments such as `telegram-cidr` are never a tag); an empty comment is **untagged** (DNS and address-list entries counted); an address-list entry whose comment starts with `mtvpn:` is an **infra pin** (its address is the pinned name); the address-list entries of a tag are attached to it by comment. | routeros.md#reading-state: two more DNS fields, so a tag whose entries were edited by hand (type, forwarder) shows as changed. |
| Desired state | `lists.View(list, exclude = the router's infra-pin names with their comments)`: per member, its tag and owned names (`own.Compute`, pins taken out first and logged "dns.google: skipped, it is an infra pin (mtvpn:doh) on Home"). Every member's tag is desired, also one that owns nothing. | router-sync.md step 3. |
| Strict match | A tag's router entries **match** desired entries when: the DNS entries' `(name, match-subdomain)` multiset equals the desired `(name, !exact)` set, every one is `type=FWD` with `forward-to=<forwarder>`, and the tag's address-list addresses equal the desired names as a multiset. | Build README defaults ("Unchanged is strict"). |
| Plan | `routers.MakePlan(want, state, applied, extra)`, pure, per tag of want ∪ router ∪ applied: desired with names → router matches → `unchanged` when the applied hash equals it, else `record` (recorded as applied, nothing pushed); doesn't match → `update`, why `new` (nothing on the router, never applied), `changed` (desired ≠ applied), `drift` (desired = applied, router differs); desired but owning nothing → `remove` when the router has entries, else `forget` when applied; not desired → router has entries: `remove` when applied (why `left the list`), `unmanaged` when never applied (unless the admin asked to remove it, 3f), router has none: `forget` when applied. `Gains` = the update installs a name the router doesn't hold under that tag. Push order: updates that gain names (in list order), other updates (list order), removals (by tag). `unchanged`, `record`, `unmanaged` and `forget` push nothing. | router-sync.md step 4 table and step 5; ADR 0013 consequence. |
| Files | The user chose **packing**: the blocks, in push order, go into files `proxier-sync-<job>-<n>.rsc` (`n` from 1) of at most 2 000 names each; a block that doesn't fit in the current file starts the next one; a block over 2 000 names is split over several files, every part after the first **continued** (no tag-removal lines, the adoption loops and adds only), so each file stays idempotent; removal blocks count as no names. Each file starts with a header comment (`# proxier sync · router Home · job #2207 · file 1/2: update openai (+31), update mine (+2)`) and a comment line before each block. Lines exactly as routeros.md#service-block (one `:set` per line; suffix names sorted, then exact ones). | routeros.md#pushing ("at most 2 000 domains per file"). |
| Push | Per file: `Client.Put` (a plain SFTP write: no temporary file, `chmod` or rename, which RouterOS's SFTP server may lack), `CmdImport` with a 30-minute timeout, `routeros.ScanImport(output)` (the patterns of routeros.md#pushing; the run's exit code too), then **always** `CmdRemoveFile`. After a file succeeds, one `Write` records each of its blocks: `update` → `routing_router_tags` upserted with `routeros.EntriesHash` and the counts (a split block once its last part succeeded); `remove` → its row deleted. A failed file (`/import` stops at the first failing line, so earlier blocks of the file may have run): the router is read again and each tag of that file that now matches its desired entries (or, for a removal, holds nothing) is recorded as above; the others keep their old applied state; then the job fails at `push`. Tags of earlier files keep their new state. | router-sync.md step 5 and 8. |
| Verify | After the last file: read again; every tag pushed must now match (updates) or hold nothing (removals); else the job fails at `verify` ("openai: 29 names on the router, 31 expected"). The applied rows already written stay: the retry re-plans and pushes again. | router-sync.md step 6. |
| The sync job | `routing.sync`: queue `routers`, resource key and coalescing key `router:<id>`, 4 attempts, backoff 5 min, 15 min, 1 h, steps `connect` and `sync`, a `Merge` that keeps `manual` when either request had it and unions `why` (≤ 10) and `remove` (3f). Payload `{router_id, trigger, manual, why, remove}`. **connect**: a router that is no longer `active` (or gone) ends the job quietly (logged, nothing recorded, `sync` skips too); connect through the target, run `CmdCheck`, update `version`, `board`, `last_seen_at`; the first success ever sets `connected_at` and records `routing.router_connected{version, board}`. **sync**: create (or, on a resume, reuse) its `routing_syncs` row (`kind = sync`, `trigger`), connect, `CmdRemoveJobFiles(job)` (files a cut-short run left), read, plan, store the plan, `read_at` and the router's `untagged` / `infra_pins` / `read_at`, write the `record` and `forget` rows, push, verify, then one `Write`: the sync row `done` with its counts, the router's `failures = 0`, `last_sync_at`, `last_sync_result = synced`; `routing.router_synced{added, updated, removed, recorded, trigger}` when anything was pushed or recorded (a sync with nothing to do records no event); `routing.router_recovered{failures, notified}` when `failures` was above 0, notifying only when `failure_notified` was set (a failure that was never notified recovers quietly); `failure_notified = 0`. | router-sync.md steps 1–8. |
| Re-plan | The `sync` step always starts from the read, also on a retry and after a restart, so it never pushes a stale plan; a block cut short by a restart differs from the desired state and is pushed again. | Build README defaults; "the job resumes and re-runs that block". |
| Failures | Any error of `connect` or `sync` (the phase: `connect`, `read`, `push`, `verify`) is recorded before the step returns it, in one `Write`: the router's `failures + 1`, `last_sync_result = failed`, `last_sync_error`; the sync row `failed` with `step` and `error`; `routing.router_sync_failed{step, error, consecutive, manual, attempt, final}` with `final` true on the job's last attempt or for an error no retry fixes (`jobs.IsPermanent`); its `NotifyIf` is `final` (the user chose: notify only when the job gives up), and a final failure sets the router's `failure_notified`. The job type's `OnFailed` records nothing (no `job.failed`); `OnCancelled` marks the sync row `cancelled` and counts nothing. `sshx` already makes a changed or unknown host key, a refused key and an off tailnet permanent: no retry. A changed key also records `ssh.host_key_changed` (sshx), the security notification. An unknown router or jump key during a sync: "first contact with 10.230.1.1:22: confirm its fingerprint with Test connection". | router-sync.md step 8; Build README defaults. |
| Connect problems | `routers.ProblemOf(conn, err) Problem{Hop, Text}` turns a connect error into the failing hop (`tailnet`, `jump`, `router`; stored in the sync row's `hop`, for 3f's per-hop table) and one sentence for the band and the sync row: "The tailnet is off (no PROXIER_TS_AUTHKEY).", "Proxier can't reach the jump host parents-pi:22: no route to host.", "The router 10.230.2.1 refused Proxier's key: install it on the router.", "The router's host key changed: accept the new key in Settings → SSH." Connect and read failures add "Nothing was changed on the router." | `RP-Phone-router` (3f draws the per-hop table from `hop`). |
| Triggers | `routers.Marker` implements `change.Marker`: the routers to sync are the **active** routers that have connected at least once (`connected_at` set; a router saved untested waits for its first passing test) following any list in `c.Lists`, any list holding a service in `c.Services`, and `c.Routers`; each gets, in the caller's transaction, `routing.sync` with `Delay = routing.sync_delay` (30 s), `trigger = change`, `why = c.Why`, `CreatedBy = c.Actor`. The jobs system coalesces them: requests merge into a queued sync that hasn't started and push its start back to 30 s after the last one; a running sync gets exactly one follow-up. | router-sync.md#triggers. |
| Sync now | `SyncNow(ctx, id, actor)`: `routing.sync` with no delay, `trigger = manual`, `manual = true`; when it merged into a delayed one, `jobs.RunNow` after the commit, so it starts at once. On the router page (primary, `s`) and on a routers-list row (`s`). | router-sync.md#triggers. |
| Test connection | `routing.test` (queue `routers`, 1 attempt, step `test`, resource key `router:<id>` for a saved router, none for the add form; payload `{test_id}`). It connects with `ConfirmFirstContact` on both hops: an `*sshx.UnknownHostError` stops it in state `confirm` with the hop (by its address), the fingerprint and the key (authorized_keys form). The admin's **It matches, continue** pins that key (`SSH.Pin(ctx, address, subject, key, "admin")`, subjects `jump:<host:port>` and `router:<id>`, or `router:new` before saving) and starts a new test of the same form; **Stop** ends it `failed` ("Stopped: the fingerprint wasn't confirmed. Nothing was pinned."). Connected: `CmdCheck` gives the checks: "RouterOS version and board" (ok), "DoH forwarder vpn-doh and mtvpn:doh pin" (ok, or the warning "This router doesn't look set up by the router script: no DoH forwarder vpn-doh."), "Entries in to_vpn_list: 1 264" (info), "File upload (SFTP)": `Client.Put` of a one-line `proxier-test-<id>.rsc` then `CmdRemoveFile` (fails when the user's group lacks `ftp`). State `passed`, `warned` or `failed` (the problem sentence). A saved router's test updates its version, board and last seen; the first pass of a router that never connected sets `connected_at`, records `routing.router_connected` and queues its initial sync (`trigger = initial`). | router-sync.md step 3; ADR 0007. |
| Add router | `GET /routing/routers/new` (`RP-Router-add`): name (1–60, unique), routing list (the default), the connection fields, Proxier's public key with **Copy**, and the install snippets with **Copy** (the user chose a dedicated user in a restricted group): on the jump host `echo '<key>' >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys`; on the router `/user group add name=proxier policy=read,write,ftp,ssh`, `/user add name=proxier group=proxier` and `/user ssh-keys add user=proxier key="<key>"` (the policies and both commands are "to verify on the first real router", open question "to verify" 5; the test's SFTP check and the import scan catch a missing policy). **Test connection** posts the form → a test row → back to the page with the test area polling every 1 s while it runs. **Save and sync** is always enabled (the user chose to allow saving untested): one `Write`: the router (`active`, `created_by = admin`), `routing.router_added{list, host, by: admin}`; when the latest test of exactly these values `passed` or `warned`, also its version, board, `connected_at` and `last_seen_at`, `routing.router_connected{version, board}` and the initial sync (`trigger = initial`, no delay); otherwise the router waits, "Not connected yet: Test connection to confirm the host keys; the initial sync runs after it passes.", and changes queue nothing for it. Then `SSH.SetSubject(router address, "router:<id>")` when its key is pinned. **Sync now** on a router that never connected is allowed and fails with the first-contact message. | router-sync.md step 4. |
| Edit | **Edit connection…** (the same fields, plus the name): `routing.router_updated{changes}` (`name`, `connection`, `names`); a new address is confirmed by the next test or fails the next sync with the first-contact message. **Routing list…**: a select; `router_updated{changes: list, from, to}` and `Change{Routers: [id]}`. Changing the names leaves the entries under the old names on the router: the page says so. | router-sync.md step 6 of routing lists ("switching it makes the next sync converge"). |
| Preview | **Preview sync** inserts a sync row (`kind = preview`, `running`) and queues `routing.preview` (queue `routers`, resource key `router:<id>`, coalescing key `preview:<id>`, 1 attempt, step `read`). It connects, reads, plans (the same functions), builds the files (named `proxier-sync-preview-<n>.rsc`) and stores the plan and the scripts (at most 4 MiB, then "… cut here") in the row. Nothing is applied or recorded besides the row; a failure marks the row `failed` and counts nothing. The router page shows the newest preview of the last hour. **Run this sync** is **Sync now** (it plans again when it runs). | router-sync.md "Preview sync". |
| Router page | `RP-Router`: crumbs, the name, the sync status (marker and word: synced, syncing, sync failed, never synced) with "42 min ago", the line "active · follows Main (14 services, 1 264 domains) · RouterOS 7.24.5 · RB5009UG+S+", **Sync now** (primary, `s`) and **Preview sync**. Areas in this DOM order: the failure band (problem, "2 in a row", "next retry at 21:32", **Test connection**); **Sync preview** (when there is one: "read from the router at 16:51:20 · nothing applied", counts "2 updates · 1 removal · 12 unchanged · 1 unmanaged, left alone", "order: tags that gain names, other updates, then removals", the plan table (tag, service, want, on router, plan, why), the script with **Copy** and **Download**, **Run this sync**, **Close**); **Tags** (the last plan: installed against desired, per tag); **Connection** (router `user@host:port`, jump host and "tailnet", the pinned fingerprints of both hops from `sshx` known hosts, address list, DoH forwarder, **Test connection**, **Edit connection…**); **Sync history** (time, kind, result, the detail "1 update · 9 s · after linkedin changed upstream", links **Plan** and **Job**; 20 rows and **Older →**); **Actions** (Routing list…, Edit connection…); **Activity** (`router:<id>`). Phone: one column, the band and the actions first. | ui/README router page; `RP-Phone-router`. |
| Routers list | 3e: `GET /routing/routers` (`RP-Routers`): **Add router** (primary, `n`); rows: router (name; under it the address "10.230.2.1 · via tailnet jump host" or "10.230.1.1 · RB5009 · 7.24.5"), state, list, last sync (result marker and word, then "3 min ago · i/o timeout · retry at 15:16" or "1 h ago · 1 tag updated"). `s` on a row is **Sync now**. | |
| Lists | `lists.Targets` adds the routers following a list with their sync word ("synced 1 h ago", "syncing", "sync failed · connect", "waits 30 s"); a list's delete already moves and marks them (3b, through `store` and `Change{Routers}`); the custom editor's footer names them ("Saving re-syncs Home and iPhone, the targets of Main."). | 3b, 3d. |
| Prune | The prune job also deletes sync rows older than 90 days (the newest 20 per router kept) and test rows older than a day. | |
| Notifications | `routing.router_sync_failed` (final only) 🔴 "{subject}: sync gave up at {step}" / "{problem}" (+ " · after {attempt} attempts" when more than one); `routing.router_recovered` (after a notified failure) 🟢 "{subject} is in sync again" / "After {failures} failed attempts." (plural forms). The button opens the router. | events.md; the user's choice. |
| Nav, search, names | Nav: **Routers** `/routing/routers`, order 50, go-to key `r` (`g r`). Search: routers by name or host; meta "router · Main · synced". `SubjectNamer`: `router` → name, `/routing/routers/<id>`. | `RP-Keys`. |

## Platform changes

| Change | Detail |
|---|---|
| `sshx.Client.Put(ctx, path string, data []byte) error` | `sftp.OpenFile(path, O_WRONLY\|O_CREATE\|O_TRUNC)`, write, close: no temporary file, no `chmod`, no `fsync`, no rename. Cancel closes the client as `Upload` does. For RouterOS; servers keep `Upload`. |
| `sshx.SSH.SetSubject(ctx, address, subject string) error` | Updates a known host's subject (bookkeeping: no event). `ErrNotFound` for an unknown address. |
| `sshxtest.Server` | A relative SFTP path resolves under the server's root directory (RouterOS writes `proxier-sync-12-1.rsc` at the file root). |

## Go signatures

### `routing/routeros`

```go
type Names struct{ List, Forwarder string } // to_vpn_list, vpn-doh
const (
	InfraPrefix = "mtvpn:"
	TelegramTag = "telegram-cidr"
	MaxDomains  = 2000
	ImportTimeout = 30 * time.Minute
)
type Entry struct {
	Name  string
	Exact bool
}
func EntriesHash(e []Entry) string // SHA-256 of the sorted (name, exact) pairs, duplicates kept

func CmdCheck(n Names) string
func CmdReadDNS(n Names) string
func CmdReadList(n Names) string
func CmdImport(file string) string
func CmdRemoveFile(file string) string
func CmdRemoveJobFiles(job string) string // job: "2207" or "preview"

type Block struct {
	Tag     string
	Remove  bool    // a removal block
	Entries []Entry // an update
}
func ServiceBlock(n Names, tag string, entries []Entry, continued bool) []string
func RemovalBlock(n Names, tag string) []string
type Part struct {
	Tag       string
	Remove    bool
	Part      int // 1.. of a split update
	Parts     int
	Continued bool
	Domains   int
}
type File struct {
	Name    string // proxier-sync-<job>-<n>.rsc
	Parts   []Part // the blocks (or block parts) in it, in order
	Domains int    // ≤ MaxDomains
	Body    []byte
}
// Files packs the blocks in order into files of at most MaxDomains names.
func Files(n Names, job, header string, blocks []Block) []File

type Check struct {
	Version, Board, Identity string
	Forwarder, Pin, Entries  int
}
type DNSEntry struct {
	Comment, Name, Type, ForwardTo string
	Subdomain                      bool
}
type ListEntry struct{ Comment, Address string }
func ParseCheck(out []byte) (Check, error)
func ParseDNS(out []byte) ([]DNSEntry, error)
func ParseList(out []byte) ([]ListEntry, error)
// ScanImport: nil, or an error quoting the first bad line. Patterns: routeros.md#pushing's,
// plus "not enough permissions" (a group without write or ftp).
func ScanImport(exitCode int, out []byte) error

// The inverses, for routerostest.
type Call struct {
	Kind  string // check, read-dns, read-list, import, remove-file, remove-job-files
	Names Names
	File  string // import, remove-file; the job for remove-job-files
}
func Parse(cmd string) (Call, bool)
type Op struct {
	Kind    string // update, continue, remove
	Tag     string
	Names   Names
	Entries []Entry
}
func ParseScript(body []byte) ([]Op, error) // only what ServiceBlock and RemovalBlock write; comment lines skipped
```

### `routing/routerostest`

```go
// Router is a fake RouterOS 7 on sshxtest.Server: the DNS static and
// address-list tables, files over SFTP, and the commands routeros builds.
// New routers come set up like fresh-router.rsc leaves them: the forwarder
// vpn-doh, the pins dns.google (mtvpn:doh) and core.telegram.org (mtvpn:tg-fetch).
type Router struct {
	Server *sshxtest.Server
	Addr   string
}
func New(t *testing.T, authorized ssh.PublicKey) *Router
func (r *Router) Seed(tag string, entries ...routeros.Entry)          // as a service block installs them
func (r *Router) SeedUntagged(name string, exact bool)
func (r *Router) SeedListOnly(comment, address string)               // telegram-cidr, a stray entry
func (r *Router) DeleteEntries(tag string, n int)                     // by hand (drift)
func (r *Router) EditForwardTo(tag, name, to string)                 // by hand
func (r *Router) Tag(tag string) (dns []routeros.DNSEntry, list []routeros.ListEntry)
func (r *Router) Tags() []string                                      // DNS comments, sorted
func (r *Router) Untagged() int
func (r *Router) Files() []string                                     // files left on the router
func (r *Router) Imports() []string                                   // imported file names, in order
func (r *Router) Import(n int) []byte                                 // the body of the nth import
func (r *Router) ImportOutput(n int, out string)                      // the nth import answers out and applies nothing
func (r *Router) FailAtBlock(n, k int, out string)                   // the nth import applies its blocks before the kth, then answers out
func (r *Router) NoFTP()                                              // SFTP writes are refused (a group without ftp)
func (r *Router) DropListAdds(tag string, n int)                      // n address-list adds of the tag fail silently (on-error)
func (r *Router) Hold(n int) (release func())                         // the nth import blocks until released
func (r *Router) NoForwarder()
func (r *Router) Offline(off bool)                                    // connections refused
// Jump is a jump host that forwards to any address.
func Jump(t *testing.T, authorized ssh.PublicKey) *sshxtest.Server
```

`/import` applies `ParseScript`'s ops with RouterOS's semantics: an update removes the tag's DNS entries in the list and its non-dynamic address-list entries (not for a continued part), then every FWD entry in the list whose name is in the block and every non-dynamic address-list entry with such an address whose comment doesn't start with `mtvpn:`, then adds the DNS entries and the address-list entries (an add that would duplicate an address already in the list is skipped, as `:do … on-error={}` does); a removal removes the tag's entries. It answers `Script file loaded and executed successfully`.

```go
var (

	ErrNotActive = errors.New("routers: the router is not active")
)
type Connection struct {
	Host     string `json:"host"`
	Port     int    `json:"port"`
	User     string `json:"user"`
	JumpHost string `json:"jump_host"`
	JumpPort int    `json:"jump_port"`
	JumpUser string `json:"jump_user"`
	Tailnet  bool   `json:"tailnet"`
	Names    routeros.Names `json:"names"`
}
func (c Connection) Validate() store.FieldErrors
func (c Connection) Target(routerID int64) sshx.Target // routerID 0: "router:new"

type Router struct {
	ID          int64
	Name        string
	ListID      int64
	List        string
	State       string // awaiting, active, paused, removing
	Conn        Connection
	Version     string
	Board       string
	ConnectedAt time.Time
	LastSeenAt  time.Time
	LastSyncAt  time.Time
	LastResult  string // "", synced, failed
	LastError   string
	Failures    int
	Untagged    int
	InfraPins   int
	ReadAt      time.Time
	CreatedBy   string
	CreatedAt   time.Time
}
type Test struct {
	ID         int64
	RouterID   int64 // 0: the add form
	Conn       Connection
	State      string // running, passed, warned, failed, confirm
	Checks     []CheckResult
	ConfirmHop string // jump, router
	ConfirmAddr, ConfirmFP string
	Version, Board, Error string
}
type CheckResult struct {
	Name   string `json:"name"`   // i18n key
	OK     bool   `json:"ok"`
	Warn   bool   `json:"warn"`
	Detail string `json:"detail"`
}

// The plan (pure).
type State struct {
	Tags          map[string]*TagState
	Untagged      int
	Pins          map[string]string // name → its mtvpn: comment
	ReadAt        time.Time
}
type TagState struct {
	DNS  []routeros.DNSEntry
	List []string // addresses
}
func Interpret(dns []routeros.DNSEntry, list []routeros.ListEntry, n routeros.Names, at time.Time) State
type Want struct {
	Tag       string
	ServiceID int64
	Selector  string // or "custom"
	Position  int
	Entries   []routeros.Entry
}
type Applied struct {
	Hash          string
	Suffix, Exact int
	At            time.Time
}
type Extra struct {
	Remove    []string // unmanaged tags the admin asked to remove (3f)
	RemoveAll bool     // removing the router (3f)
}
type TagPlan struct {
	Tag      string `json:"tag"`
	Service  string `json:"service"`
	Want     int    `json:"want"` // -1: not desired
	Have     int    `json:"have"` // DNS entries on the router
	Action   string `json:"action"` // unchanged, record, update, remove, unmanaged, forget
	Why      string `json:"why"`    // new, changed, drift, left-list, owns-nothing, never-installed, asked
	Gains    bool   `json:"gains"`
	Entries  []routeros.Entry `json:"-"`
}
func Desired(v lists.View) []Want
func MakePlan(want []Want, st State, applied map[string]Applied, x Extra) []TagPlan // push order first
func Blocks(plan []TagPlan) []routeros.Block
func Matches(t *TagState, want []routeros.Entry, n routeros.Names) bool

type Sync struct {
	ID         int64
	RouterID   int64
	JobID      int64
	Kind       string // sync, preview (3f: drift, removal)
	Trigger    string
	State      string
	Step       string
	Error      string
	ReadAt     time.Time
	Plan       []TagPlan
	Script     string // preview
	Added, Updated, Removed, Unchanged, Recorded int
	StartedAt, FinishedAt time.Time
}

type Deps struct {
	DB       *db.DB
	Events   *events.Catalog
	Settings *settings.Store
	Jobs     *jobs.System
	SSH      *sshx.SSH
	Tailnet  *tailnet.Node // may be nil
	Lists    *lists.Service
	Services *services.Service
	Now      func() time.Time
	Log      *slog.Logger
}
type Service struct{ /* … */ }
func New(d Deps) *Service

func (s *Service) Marker() change.Marker
func (s *Service) StartTest(ctx context.Context, routerID int64, c Connection, actor string) (testID int64, err error)
func (s *Service) Test(ctx context.Context, id int64) (Test, error)
func (s *Service) Confirm(ctx context.Context, testID int64, trust bool, actor string) (newTestID int64, err error)
// Create saves the router; testID 0 or a test of other values: saved untested, waiting for a passing test.
func (s *Service) Create(ctx context.Context, name string, listID int64, c Connection, testID int64, actor string) (int64, error) // store.FieldErrors
func (s *Service) Get(ctx context.Context, id int64) (Router, error)
func (s *Service) List(ctx context.Context) ([]Router, error)
func (s *Service) ByList(ctx context.Context, listID int64) ([]Router, error)
func (s *Service) Edit(ctx context.Context, id int64, name string, c Connection, actor string) (changed bool, err error)
func (s *Service) SetList(ctx context.Context, id, listID int64, actor string) error
func (s *Service) SyncNow(ctx context.Context, id int64, actor string) (jobID int64, err error) // ErrNotActive
func (s *Service) Preview(ctx context.Context, id int64, actor string) (syncID int64, err error)
func (s *Service) Syncs(ctx context.Context, id, before int64, limit int) ([]Sync, error)
func (s *Service) SyncRecord(ctx context.Context, id, syncID int64) (Sync, error)
func (s *Service) LatestPreview(ctx context.Context, id int64) (Sync, bool, error)
func (s *Service) Applied(ctx context.Context, id int64) (map[string]Applied, error)
func (s *Service) JobTypes() []jobs.Type // routing.sync, routing.preview, routing.test
type Problem struct {
	Hop  string // tailnet, jump, router
	Text string
}
func ProblemOf(c Connection, err error) Problem
```

### `routing/routingtest` additions

```go
// Router starts a fake router, adds it as an active router following the
// list (Main when 0) with its host key pinned, and returns both. With
// ViaJump, a fake jump host sits in front of it.
func (h *Harness) Router(name string, listID int64, opts ...RouterOption) (*routerostest.Router, int64)
func ViaJump() RouterOption
func (h *Harness) JobsOf(typ string) []jobs.Job
func (h *Harness) StopJobs() // as serverstest: the workers stop, a running job is marked interrupted
```

The harness maps every fake's address through `sshx.SSH.Dial` (1e's seam), so no real port is dialled twice.

## Routes

| Method, path | What |
|---|---|
| `GET /routing/routers` | Routers |
| `GET /routing/routers/new` | Add router (`?test=<id>` shows that test with its form) |
| `POST /routing/routers/test` | Start a test of the posted form (or `router=<id>` for a saved one) |
| `GET /routing/routers/tests/:test` | The test area (htmx poll) |
| `POST /routing/routers/tests/:test/confirm` | `decision=trust\|stop` |
| `POST /routing/routers` | Save and sync |
| `GET /routing/routers/:id` | Router page |
| `POST /routing/routers/:id/sync` | Sync now |
| `POST /routing/routers/:id/preview`, `GET /routing/routers/:id/preview` | Start a preview; the preview area (htmx poll) |
| `GET /routing/routers/:id/syncs/:sync`, `/syncs/:sync/script.rsc` | A sync's plan; a preview's script as a download |
| `GET /routing/routers/:id/edit`, `POST /routing/routers/:id/edit` | Edit connection and name |
| `GET /routing/routers/:id/list`, `POST /routing/routers/:id/list` | Routing list |

## Events

Recorded in 3e: `routing.router_added`, `routing.router_updated`, `routing.router_connected`, `routing.router_synced`, `routing.router_sync_failed`, `routing.router_recovered`.

## Doc changes in the same commit

- `docs/integrations/routeros.md`: the DNS read prints type and forward-to too, fields split from the right; packing into files of 2 000 names with continued parts, and the re-read after a failed file; "not enough permissions" among the error patterns; `Put` without a temporary file; leftover files of a job removed first; Proxier's own user in a group with `read,write,ftp,ssh` and the dialog's commands, marked "to verify".
- `docs/processes/routing/router-sync.md`: strict matching (type and forwarder count); a failure is recorded per attempt and notifies only when the job gives up (recovery notifies only after such a failure); Save works untested and the router then waits for its first passing test; a sync with nothing to do records no event; the plan's `record` and `forget` rows; a tag owning nothing in the list is removed; the first-contact message during a sync; the job re-plans on every attempt.
- `docs/modules/routing.md#router-sync`: the same in short; the first hop is direct or through the tailnet.
- `docs/events.md#routing`: the router events' payloads and texts.
- `docs/open-questions.md` "to verify" 5: SFTP is used (macOS's `scp` since OpenSSH 9.0 speaks SFTP, which mtvpn relied on); the `ssh-keys add` command is still to verify on the first real router.

## Checklist

RouterOS text, in `routeros/` (pure):

- [ ] A two-domain service block is exactly routeros.md#service-block's lines (suffix first, one `:set` per line); a removal block is its two lines — `blocks_test.go` `TestServiceBlockMatchesTheDoc`
- [ ] Small blocks share a file up to 2 000 names, in push order; a block that doesn't fit starts the next file; 6 000 names of one tag become three files, the second and third continued; removals ride along; each file and block has its header — `files_test.go` `TestFilesPackAndSplit`
- [ ] `ParseScript` reads back every block `ServiceBlock`/`RemovalBlock` write, continued parts included; anything else is an error — `parse_test.go` `TestParseScriptInvertsBlocks`
- [ ] `Parse` recognises every `Cmd*` and nothing else — `parse_test.go` `TestParseCommands`
- [ ] Reads with CRLF lines, an empty comment, an `mtvpn:` comment, a hand comment containing `|`, `match-subdomain` true and false — `read_test.go` `TestParseReadOutput`
- [ ] `ScanImport`: each error pattern (and "not enough permissions") fails naming its line; "Script file loaded and executed successfully" passes; a non-zero exit fails — `scan_test.go` `TestScanImport`

The plan, in `routers/plan_test.go` (pure):

- [ ] Every row of the plan table: matching and applied → `unchanged`; matching, never applied → `record`; differing → `update` (`new`, `changed`, `drift`); applied, left the list → `remove`; never applied, not desired → `unmanaged`; owning nothing → `remove`; applied but gone → `forget` — `TestPlanTable`
- [ ] A wrong `forward-to`, a wrong `match-subdomain`, a missing address-list name or a duplicate entry make a tag differ — `TestStrictMatch`
- [ ] Updates gaining names come before other updates, then removals — `TestPushOrder`

Sync, in `routers/` (`routingtest` + `routerostest`, jobs running):

- [ ] Add a router behind a jump host: the test stops twice for confirmations (jump, then router), each **It matches** pins and re-tests; it then shows version and board with no warning; **Save** creates it, records `router_added` and `router_connected`, and the initial sync runs — `test_test.go` `TestAddRouterBehindJumpHost`
- [ ] **Stop** at the jump host's fingerprint → the test ends failed and nothing is pinned — `test_test.go` `TestDeclineFingerprintPinsNothing`
- [ ] A router without `vpn-doh` → the "doesn't look set up by the router script" warning; **Save** still allowed — `test_test.go` `TestMissingForwarderWarns`
- [ ] **Save** without a test (or with values the last test didn't use) → the router is saved but waits: no `router_connected`, no initial sync, and a change to its list queues nothing; its first passing test records `router_connected` and queues the initial sync — `test_test.go` `TestSaveUntestedWaitsForTest`
- [ ] A router user whose group lacks `ftp` → the test's "File upload (SFTP)" check fails — `test_test.go` `TestUploadCheck`
- [ ] First sync of a router mtvpn manages (its tags seeded as mtvpn installed them), with "Main" holding those services → every matching tag `record`ed, nothing uploaded — `sync_test.go` `TestFirstSyncOfMtvpnRouterPushesNothing`
- [ ] Adding `v2fly:openai` to "Main" → one sync 30 s later with one update file for `openai` — `sync_test.go` `TestAddServiceSyncsOnce`
- [ ] Five services added within a minute → one sync with five update files — `sync_test.go` `TestChangesCoalesce`
- [ ] Two accepted refreshes of services in "Main" → one sync — `sync_test.go` `TestTwoRefreshesOneSync`
- [ ] `v2fly:openai` removed from "Main" → the next sync removes tag `openai` — `sync_test.go` `TestRemovedServiceIsRemoved`
- [ ] Reordering "Main" moves `claude.ai` from `anthropic` to `mine` → `mine` is pushed first; after each import the router holds `claude.ai` — `sync_test.go` `TestGainingTagPushedFirst`
- [ ] `anthropic` taken out of "Main" → `claude.ai` stays on the router under `mine` — `sync_test.go` `TestNameNeverLostWhenOwnerLeaves`
- [ ] Custom tag `mine` renamed `personal` → the sync installs `personal` and then removes `mine` — `sync_test.go` `TestRenamedTagReplaced`
- [ ] An untagged `chatgpt.com` and the desired `openai` holding it → the untagged entry replaced by a tagged one — `sync_test.go` `TestUntaggedDuplicateAdopted`
- [ ] An untagged `example.org` no tag wants → left alone, counted as untagged — `sync_test.go` `TestUntaggedLeftAlone`
- [ ] A snapshot holding `dns.google` → not installed on a router where it is a pin, and the skip logged — `sync_test.go` `TestInfraPinNeverInstalled`
- [ ] Two files, the second holding tags `b` and `c`; its import runs `b` and fails at `c` with "syntax error" (`FailAtBlock`) → the sync fails at `push`, that file is deleted, the router is read again: `a` (first file) and `b` keep their new applied state, `c` its old one — `push_test.go` `TestImportErrorKeepsEarlierTags`
- [ ] Address-list adds failing silently → the sync fails at `verify`, naming the tag and counts — `push_test.go` `TestVerifyCatchesMismatch`
- [ ] The router offline → fails at `connect`, retried after 5 min, 15 min and 1 h; only the fourth attempt's failure (`final`) passes its `NotifyIf`; back online → `router_recovered{notified: true}` notifies. A sync that fails once and then succeeds recovers without a notification — `sync_test.go` `TestOfflineRetriesAndRecovers`
- [ ] **Sync now** merging into a delayed sync starts it at once; a permanent error (a refused key) is `final` at its first attempt and notifies — `sync_test.go` `TestSyncNowRunsAtOnce`
- [ ] The process stops during the second import (`Router.Hold(2)`, then `h.StopJobs()`, as servers' `TestResumeAtBaseBootstrap` does) → the job is interrupted; after `h.StartJobs()` it resumes, re-plans, pushes that tag again, removes the leftover file, and the tag ends correct — `sync_test.go` `TestRestartDuringImport`
- [ ] The router's host key changed → the sync fails permanently with "host key changed", nothing uploaded, `ssh.host_key_changed` recorded — `sync_test.go` `TestChangedHostKeyStopsSync`
- [ ] Switching the router from "Main" to "Parents" → the preview shows removals for tags missing from "Parents"; running it removes them — `preview_test.go` `TestSwitchListPreviewAndSync`
- [ ] A list with 6 000 names in one tag → three files, all imported, the tag verified — `push_test.go` `TestBigTagSplitsAcrossFiles`
- [ ] A preview changes nothing on the router and records no event; its failure counts nothing — `preview_test.go` `TestPreviewIsReadOnly`
- [ ] A change never queues a sync for a router that isn't active or never connected — `marker_test.go` `TestMarkerSkipsInactiveRouters`

Platform, in `internal/platform/sshx/`:

- [ ] `Put` writes the file with no temporary name and no rename; `SetSubject` changes a known host's subject — `client_test.go` `TestPutAndSetSubject`

Pages, in `pages/routers_test.go`:

- [ ] The add page shows the key and the group, user and key snippets, the test area polls and shows confirmations and checks; **Save** works with or without a test, and the router page of an untested router says it waits for a test — `TestAddRouterPage`
- [ ] The router page shows the status, the preview with plan and script, tags, connection with fingerprints, history and activity; the phone width stacks it — `TestRouterPage`
- [ ] The routers list shows each column; the list page shows routers as targets — `TestRoutersListAndTargets`
- [ ] The two notification texts in EN and RU — `notify_test.go` `TestRouterNotificationTexts`
